title: High school defends staying silent while boys made AI nudes of 59 classmates
summary: In a motion to dismiss this week, Lancaster Country Day School (LCDS)—a private K-12 school in Pennsylvania with fewer than 600 students—argued that it was false to say the school never reported the harm to law enforcement.
